entries.title: Books are loaned for three weeks
entries.text: Books are loaned for three weeks and audiobooks for two. The period is counted from the day of checkout.

entries.title: A loan renews at most twice
entries.text: A loan renews at most twice, and not at all when another member has reserved the title.

entries.title: Overdue fines are capped at the replacement price
entries.text: Overdue fines accrue per day and stop at the replacement price of the item.

entries.title: Small fines are waived at the desk
entries.text: Fines under one euro are waived automatically when the member returns the item at the desk.

entries.title: Reservations are served in order
entries.text: Reservations are served in the order they were placed. A member who is skipped twice loses their place in the queue.

entries.title: A reserved title is held for five days
entries.text: A reserved title waits on the hold shelf at the desk for five days before it goes to the next member.

entries.title: Every record has an ISBN or an accession number
entries.text: Every catalogue record has a thirteen digit ISBN or, for older items, an internal accession number.

entries.title: The publisher feed created duplicate records
entries.text: Importing the publisher feed created duplicate records because the ISBN was compared with its hyphens still in. Strip them before comparing.

entries.title: Language codes were stored in two cases
entries.text: The language field uses two letter codes, and Korean records were stored both as KO and as ko, so a filter missed half of them.

entries.title: Library cards expire after two years
entries.text: Library cards expire after two years and renew at the desk with proof of address.

entries.title: Child members cannot borrow adult items
entries.text: Child members cannot borrow items rated adult, and the desk screen shows a warning when one is scanned.

entries.title: Loan history is deleted after thirty days
entries.text: Loan history is deleted thirty days after the item is returned and only the counts are kept.

entries.title: Catalogue search ranked old editions first
entries.text: The public catalogue search ranked old editions first. Break ties by publication year, newest first.

entries.title: Search tolerates one typo per word
entries.text: Search tolerates one typo per word using edit distance, but never for an ISBN.

entries.title: Night shelf scans miss misfiled items
entries.text: The night shelf scan misses items filed under the wrong classification mark, because it only looks where the mark says the item belongs.

entries.title: Classification marks follow the Dewey scheme
entries.text: Classification marks follow the Dewey scheme with a three letter author code appended.

entries.title: The return box is emptied each morning
entries.text: Items from the return box are checked in every morning before the library opens.

entries.title: Damaged returns are held and photographed
entries.text: A returned item with damage is held back and photographed before the member is charged anything.

entries.title: Meeting rooms book in one hour blocks
entries.text: Meeting rooms book in one hour blocks, up to a week ahead.

entries.title: Two groups booked the same room
entries.text: Two groups booked the same room because the overlap check compared local times across the clock change in spring. Compare in UTC.

entries.title: Pickup notices go by text message first
entries.text: Pickup notices go by text message first, and by email only if the member has no phone number on file.

entries.title: No notices overnight
entries.text: Notices are not sent between ten at night and seven in the morning; they wait for the morning batch.

entries.title: The catalogue database is copied nightly
entries.text: The catalogue database is copied every night and one copy per week is kept for a year.

entries.title: A restore test passed with the loans table empty
entries.text: A restore test passed although the loans table came back empty, because the check only counted catalogue rows. Count every table.

entries.title: The annual report counts loans per branch
entries.text: The annual report counts loans per branch and not per member, to protect member privacy.

entries.title: Branch totals double counted transfers
entries.text: Branch totals double counted items that were transferred between branches during the year.

entries.title: Donated books are sorted within a month
entries.text: Donated books are sorted into keep, sell and recycle within a month of arriving.

entries.title: Large print and audio records carry a flag
entries.text: Large print and audiobook records carry an accessibility flag in the catalogue so they can be listed together.
